text: Want this fan-made Golden Gate Bridge to become a real LEGO set? Supporting on LEGO Ideas is free and takes just a minute! Every vote pushes this build toward 10k. Help hit the next milestone: https://ideas.lego.com/product-ideas/6726571d-0a01-411f-b5ac-425634ecf4e5 #LEGO #AFOL
